# oriz-diagram

> Free online Mermaid diagram editor. Write flowcharts, sequence, ER, Gantt and class diagrams as text, render live, export clean SVG or PNG. 100% client-side — no upload, no signup, free. Optional AI turns plain English into Mermaid.

Live app: https://diagram.oriz.in

## Pages

- [Editor](https://diagram.oriz.in/): live split code/preview Mermaid editor with templates, zoom, export, and optional AI.

## Features

- [Live editor](https://diagram.oriz.in/#editor): type Mermaid text, render debounced as you type, zoom the preview.
- [Templates](https://diagram.oriz.in/#editor): one-click flowchart, sequence, ER, Gantt, and class diagrams.
- [Export SVG/PNG](https://diagram.oriz.in/#editor): download vector SVG or 2x raster PNG built from the SVG via canvas.
- [Drag-drop load](https://diagram.oriz.in/#editor): drop a .mmd or .txt file onto the preview to open it.
- [Optional AI](https://diagram.oriz.in/#editor): describe a process in English to get Mermaid code, or fix broken syntax. Powered by g4f multi-provider failover, no key. Editor still works if AI is down.

## About

- [About / info page](https://chirag127.github.io/oriz-diagram/): what oriz-diagram is, features, and tech.
- [Source (GitHub)](https://github.com/chirag127/oriz-diagram): MIT-licensed source.
- [Full LLM text](https://diagram.oriz.in/llms-full.txt): complete site content as markdown for AI ingestion.
